title: Impact of the Big Five Personality Traits on Entrepreneurial Intentions among Qatar University Students
core_idea: To assess the impact of the Big Five personality traits on entrepreneurial intentions among Qatar University students using a descriptive-analytical approach with a validated questionnaire emailed to the university community (502 responses) and supplementary secondary data.
tldr: A survey-based descriptive-analytical study investigating how the Big Five personality traits relate to entrepreneurial intentions in Qatar University students.
